intent: Compile an ordinary-language multi-capability mission into the smallest evidence-backed compatible Godskill composition without relying on a host semantic proposal.
successCondition: A mission with independently evidenced compatible capabilities reaches the existing bounded router as a composition, while single-skill, ambiguous, unsafe, and unauthorized missions preserve their prior outcomes.
outputs: selected compatible composition or explicit decision
operations: retain only independently evidenced mutually compatible cards
delegate final capability coverage and policy selection to the existing router
positiveTriggers: one mission explicitly asks for security appraisal and a tested repository repair
one mission contains two distinct compatible capability outcomes
negativeTriggers: one specialist mission merely contains generic words such as review or workflow
a broad mission names several domains without enough capability evidence
the candidate cards are incompatible or exceed the host composition bound
failureModes: evidence is too weak or ambiguous
a requested effect exceeds host permission
